scientific_boundary: Accepted target-family members only.
Gene-tree annotation is not species-tree evidence.
Zero is current non-detection, not validated loss.
Aligned sequence conservation is not validated structure.
Negative introns are forbidden.
Independent units are species-level summaries.
Pairwise tests require a passing global gate.
Target-family HOG membership is not a whole-genome pangenome.
Annotation absence is not validated gene loss.
HOG and gene denominators remain separate.
Fractions require absolute denominators.
Species chromosomes use separate physical axes.
Each gene has one explicit assignment state.
Descriptive association is not causality.
Similarity hits cannot enter as synteny anchors.
Only ordered multi-anchor whole-genome blocks render.
Each species pair is audited independently.
Family highlights are a subset of passing genome-wide anchors.
Pairwise Ka/Ks does not prove positive selection.
Inference uses dependency-aware cluster units.
Clipping and overlap remain visible.
Motif hit is not TF binding.
Scaled values retain raw denominators.
HOG-level motif-hit composition is descriptive and is not enrichment or TF-binding evidence.
TPM is descriptive and not a DESeq2 input.
NOT_APPLICABLE and MISSING_IN_INPUT are distinct.
Cross-species absolute TPM comparison is blocked.
Formal DE requires non-negative integers.
Each dataset is fitted independently.
Only registered estimable contrasts are reported.
BH-FDR and effect size remain separate.
VST is a sample-pattern object, not log2FC.
Overlap membership follows declared thresholds.
Raw counts are never pooled across studies.
Only generated pairs may be presented as figures.
TSV is authoritative; XLSX parity is audited.
Runtime status must not overstate missing gates.
Hashes cover generated result files except the manifest pair itself.
